steps.name: context-change-queued
steps.subject: Input listener: apply a text-input context change after its Wayland batch
steps.description:
Text fields can disable and re-enable text-input in one Wayland batch; applying each change at once
unmapped and remapped the keyboard in between (flicker). The context change and the hide on
deactivate are queued, so only the final state applies; the composition is still reset at once.

dep3.X-Rungic-Status: Pending [a plain bug; check upstream master first]

steps.name: language-popup-lifetime
steps.subject: Language popup: no live binding to the key that opened it
steps.description:
A language change destroys the key that opened the popup; its position bindings then referred to a
deleted item after closing or rotating. The popup takes the position once and closes when the
keyboard panel's size changes.

dep3.X-Rungic-Status: Pending [a plain bug; check upstream master first]
